sources.title: Codestral launch announcement
sources.evidence: May 29, 2024 launch identifies the original 22B open-weight code model, 32k context, instruction and fill-in-the-middle modes, and training on 80+ programming languages. Links the exact Hugging Face checkpoint and MNPL. Its LangChain integration account describes instruct tool use.

sources.title: Codestral 24.05 model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact codestral-2405 page links Codestral-22B-v0.1 weights and explicitly reports Parameters(B)=22 and Active(B)=22. Confirms May 29 release, MNPL, 32k context and June 16, 2025 API retirement. These are nominal developer counts, not an exact learned-tensor census.

sources.title: Codestral-22B-v0.1 model card
sources.evidence: Exact model card documents text/code instruction and FIM generation, downloadable weights and mistral_common v3 as reference tokenizer. Card metadata links MNPL-0.1; its body has the transposed abbreviation MNLP-0.1. No dedicated thinking mode is described.

sources.title: Codestral-22B-v0.1 Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: MistralForCausalLM, 56 layers, hidden size 6144, FFN size 16384, 48 query heads and 8 KV heads, vocab 32768, untied embeddings, BF16 and max_position_embeddings=32768. No routed expert or multimodal modules.

sources.title: Codestral-22B-v0.1 native parameters
sources.evidence: Native inference configuration independently confirms 56 layers, dim6144, head_dim128, 48 query/8 KV heads, hidden_dim16384 and vocab32768; no MoE configuration.

sources.title: Mistral AI Non-Production License 0.1
sources.evidence: Linked actual license names the Mistral AI Non-Production License. Section3 restricts use to testing, research, personal or evaluation purposes in non-production environments; other uses require a separate license. Not Apache-2.0.

sources.title: Mistral reference inference library README
sources.evidence: Official repository directly lists the original Codestral 22B v0.1 download and states that all models in that table support function calling. Documents native tool schemas through mistral_common and Codestral chat/FIM usage. The library is now archived; this is documented capability, not present hosted service verification.

sources.title: Mistral reference Transformer layers
sources.evidence: Static inspection defines grouped-query causal attention, SwiGLU feed-forward blocks and RMSNorm. TransformerBlock selects the ordinary dense FeedForward path when the model has no MoE arguments, as in the Codestral params. No remote code was executed.

sources.title: Codestral-22B-v0.1 tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: Contains TOOL_CALLS, AVAILABLE_TOOLS and TOOL_RESULTS special tokens. Its bundled Jinja template only supports alternating user/assistant plus initial system messages, so that template alone does not implement native tool serialization; the card recommends mistral_common. No thinking-mode serialization is established.

sources.title: Codestral official repository metadata and bounded access probe
sources.evidence: Public ungated repository at revision 28b1c1a51dabe9d86ca8c41420ada1984632498f. A pinned model-00001-of-00009.safetensors bytes 0-7 request returned HTTP 206 with Content-Range bytes 0-7/4882298776 and exactly 8 bytes. Full weights were not downloaded.

sources.title: Codestral-22B-v0.1 checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Index contains 507 tensor keys in 9 shards, including ordinary dense attention/MLP/norm and embedding/output weights. No exact parameter total is derived from index byte size or Hugging Face aggregate metadata.

name.note: Exact original checkpoint identifier; distinct from later hosted Codestral2501/2508 versions and Codestral Mamba.

developer.note: Developer-owned release and official mistralai checkpoint; retains normalized catalog name.

release_date.note: Developer launch date and exact retrospective model page agree.

open_weights.note: Official public weights and successful bounded unauthenticated shard probe. Open weights does not imply unrestricted commercial use.

license.note: MNPL 0.1 actual linked license; preserve its official full name, not the model-card body typo. Commercial licensing is separate.

parameters_b.note: Developer nominal total, explicitly reported rather than inferred from the model name. No exact checkpoint census is claimed.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer explicitly publishes 22B in the Active(B) column for this exact original model. This is a nominal disclosure; equality to total is not inferred merely because the network is dense, and the counting convention is not separately defined.

architecture.note: Decoder-only dense Transformer with full grouped-query attention, 56 layers, 48 query/8 KV heads, SwiGLU feed-forward networks and RMSNorm. Not the later Codestral Mamba architecture.

context_window.note: Exact released checkpoint max_position_embeddings 32768 resolves the advertised 32k shorthand. Does not assert current API operation; the original endpoint is retired.

modalities.note: Native code/text inputs and generated text; configuration has no vision/audio encoder or decoder.

reasoning.note: A dedicated thinking-mode contract could not be verified for this exact model. Ordinary code reasoning and instruction following do not establish such a mode; missing template markers alone do not prove incapability. Clear the unsupported categorical false.

tool_call.note: Official reference-library supported-model table includes original Codestral 22B; launch integration also describes instruct tool use. Use the documented mistral_common v3 serialization: the limited bundled Hugging Face Jinja template alone omits tool handling. Current hosted endpoint operation was not tested.

description.value: Dense code model trained on over 80 programming languages, supporting instruction following, fill-in-the-middle completion and native tool calls.
description.note: Factual architecture/training/capabilities; avoids an ambiguous open-source label for MNPL weights.

patch.description: Dense code model trained on over 80 programming languages, supporting instruction following, fill-in-the-middle completion and native tool calls.

sources.label: Codestral official repository metadata and bounded access probe

patch.notes: 22B total and 22B active are developer nominal figures; the original model documentation explicitly gives both, without defining an exact tensor-count convention. The checkpoint is a dense GQA Transformer with 32768 positions. Weights use MNPL 0.1, with commercial licensing separate. Native tool calling is documented through mistral_common; the bundled Hugging Face Jinja template does not itself serialize tools. Dedicated thinking-mode status is unverified. Mistral marks codestral-2405 retired June 16, 2025; published weights remain accessible.

summary: Verified original Codestral 22B release, MNPL 0.1, public weights, 32768 context and text modalities. Adds dense Transformer architecture, directly disclosed nominal 22B active count and native function calling; changes parameter provenance from model name to primary evidence. Dedicated thinking-mode status remains unverified and the unsupported false is cleared. Distinguishes reference tokenizer tool support from the limited Hugging Face template and documents original API retirement.
